display_bead_direction: „Perlenrichtung“ is not a natural German compound and leaves the setting unclear; the toggle draws arrows showing which way to slide the beads (DrawScopeEx.kt), so name the arrows.
please_enter_mobile_number: Field label mobile_number is „Handynummer“; the error used „Telefonnummer“ – one term inside the chunk.
home_promo_tagline: Word order: „lernt lesen mit Lauten“ reads unpolished (Ausklammerung); „lernt mit Lauten lesen“ is the natural sentence, same length.
home_week_tap: German Android convention is „Zum Ansehen tippen“ (like „Zum Öffnen tippen“); „Tippen zum Ansehen“ is word-for-word English order.
faq_que_1: Product name must match the glossary decision „Abakus für Kinder - Kopfrechnen“ (hyphen, as in the fr/es masters and the store-title pattern), not an en dash.
share_with_friend_text: „Vedaavi Abakus“ is not a product name in any store; the share text names the app by its store title like fr/es/id/vi do (glossary: „Abakus für Kinder - Kopfrechnen“), set in „“ so the name is not read as the subject matter.
yes_i_m_sure: Button confirms „Möchten Sie sich wirklich abmelden?“ and „Willst du die Prüfung wirklich verlassen?“; „Ja, sicher“ reads as a casual „yeah, sure“, not as „I am certain“ (fr/es/pt also keep the full sentence).
ob_free_first_days: The one form dropped the %1$d placeholder (brief rule 1); „1. TAG GRATIS“ keeps it, stays natural and still says „first“. other unchanged.
l1_lesson1_step2_body: „Stange“ is almost the same word as „Stab“ (the rods that hold the beads), so a child could mix up the beam with the rods; chunk 02 (tour_step_03) already calls the beam „Balken“ / „Mittelsteg“, use the same.
l1_phase_practice: Glossary decision chunk 04: the Practice STEP inside a lesson (Lernen / Üben / Quiz) is „Üben“; „Training“ is reserved for the app's Abacus Practice mode (Abakus-Training).
l1_practice_complete: Same rule: „Training“ is the app mode, this card closes the „Üben“ step of a lesson; „Fertig geübt!“ is the natural child wording and also fits the Level 2 practice screen that reuses the key.
l1_rod_zero: Factual error carried over from the English: for 0 the upper bead stays UP, so „alle Perlen unten“ is wrong. Glossary rule for all new languages: „all beads away from the beam“, same wording as l1_instr_zero / l1_lesson2_step1_body („weg vom Mittelsteg“).
l1_rod_heaven_earth: „obere Perle + 2 untere Perlen oben“ lets the final „oben“ attach to the upper bead as well (upper bead UP = not counted); „obere Perle unten“ states where the 5-bead sits, as in l1_rod_heaven („nur die obere Perle unten“).
l4_msg_good: "Good effort" is the middle-score message, not full praise: "Gut versucht" as in chunk 04 (l1_quiz_good), "Gut gemacht" says well done
balloon_pop_desc: "die zur 10 passt" is vague; the school phrase for the complement is "die zur 10 fehlt" (Was fehlt zur 10?), same length
merge2048_desc: "Zahlen vereinen" is not said in German (vereinen = unite people/countries); "zusammenfügen" is the natural merge verb
trophy_speed_200_desc: "in irgendeinem Spiel" reads careless ("in whatever game"); "in einem Spiel" = in any one game, shorter for the one-line trophy card
formal_exam: Binding glossary decision (chunk 02): Formal Exam = „Offizielle Prüfung“ (practice_set = „Training zur offiziellen Prüfung“); „Prüfungsmodus“ breaks the link between the chip and the set name.
select_exam_types: Glossary (de chunk 03): „exam types“ = Prüfungsarten everywhere; benefit_all_exams / paywall_subtitle_exam already say „Prüfungsarten“, the setup screen used „Rechenarten“.
benefit_all_levels: Plural of Level is „Level“ (no -s) in chunks 01/02 and the glossary (chunk 06); „in allen Levels“ also forces an awkward dative, so „für alle Level“.
paywall_subtitle_generic: Plural „Level“, not „Levels“ (app-wide decision, chunks 01/02 use „alle Level“).
freemium_body_pick: Plural „Level“, not „Levels“ (chunk 01 billing_issue_message: „alle Level, Spiele und Berichte“).
purchase_benefit_2: „Perlenrichtung“ was rejected in the chunk 01 review as an unnatural compound (display_bead_direction = „Richtungspfeile anzeigen“); the feature is the direction arrows on the beads, so name them the same way.
paywall_subtitle_tables: Mixed times-table practice is „Gemischtes Üben“ in the glossary (de chunk 06); „Training“ is reserved for the Abacus Practice mode.
paywall_percent_off: Standalone label on its own row of the plan card (PaywallKit / PurchasePlanCard): a German label starts with a capital, as paywall_save_vs_monthly already does („Ca. …“); the bracketed _extra variant may stay lowercase.
paywall_intro_first_days: Fills „%1$s, danach <price>“ on a one-line (maxLines = 1) plan-card text; „In den ersten 3 Tagen, danach …“ is 60 % longer than the English, the nominal „Erste 3 Tage, danach 4,99 € / Monat“ reads like a normal German offer line and fits.
paywall_intro_first_weeks: Same one-line length fix as paywall_intro_first_days.
paywall_intro_first_months: Same one-line length fix as paywall_intro_first_days.
paywall_intro_first_years: Same one-line length fix as paywall_intro_first_days.

g_number_detective_2: Shown when the tries run out: 'Verpasst' reads as 'missed an event'; 'Nicht geknackt' pairs with 'Geknackt!' and 'Knack die Zahl'

htp_number_path_13: Same English as chunk 07 htp_cross_math_15 / htp_kakuro_13: made identical to the chunk 07 wording
htp_number_sequence_puzzle_15: 'erstes Programmier-Denken' is not natural German; 'wie beim Programmieren' says the same (early coding mindset)
missing_operator_tagline: 'das Zeichen, das stimmt' loses 'makes it true' and is not idiomatic for a sign
number_snake_tagline: 'Verbinde von 1 ...' has no object; verbinden needs one (die Zahlen)
hide_options: Compact Sudoku button (maxLines 1, clip) in a row with 'Tipp 1/3' and 'Neustart': 22 chars was too long, 'ein/aus' mirrors 'Ton an/aus'
show_options: Same button, show state: short 'Hilfszahlen ein' with the eye icon
htp_place_value_14: 'Null-Falle' is not a German term; 'versteckte Null' is what a parent understands (zero-trap numbers)
htp_true_false_12: 'blitzschnelles Abrufen' had no object (recall of what); 'von Ergebnissen' completes 'instant fact recall'
clock_master_tagline: Same English as chunk 06 clock_master_desc (already 'Lies die Uhr, besiege die Zeit!' in values-de); 'schlag die Zeit' is not idiomatic German, 'besiege die Zeit' is.
l2_lesson4_step5_body: Reading verified: lesson 4 pool is subtract 5-9 from 5-9 with result < 5, so "Subtract more" = minus 6 to 9; "Mehr als 5 minus" is unnatural word order, "Minus mehr als 5" is parallel to "Minus 5" and clear.
l2_lesson5_step2_body: Bead move: from 3 (3 untere oben) to 8 you only push the heaven bead down, the 3 earth beads stay (animation 3 → ones(true,3)); "wechsle zur oberen" tells the child to swap the earth beads away, which gives 5, not 8.
l2_lesson10_step3_body: Factual error carried over from the English: 6 = obere + 1 untere, so "obere nach OBEN (6→1) ... 4 untere dazu" is impossible (only 3 earth beads free) and the app animates 6 → 15 as tens +1 and ONE earth bead down with the heaven bead staying (l2FormulaRodMovements(6, 15, 2)); numbers kept, moves now match the animation.
l2_phase_apply: "+4 wird gerechnet" is not idiomatic with a term as subject; "Jetzt kommt +4" is natural and fits the phase sequence Start bei 0 → 3 wird eingestellt → Jetzt: 3 → Jetzt kommt +4 → Ergebnis: 7.
l3_secs: Seconds were written two ways in the chunk ("30 s" on the time chips, "Sek." in l3_unit_sec); chunk 02 report_seconds_value is "%1$d Sek." too, so the chips use the same unit.
